modifications: Namespace imports rewritten from wavjepa to src.vendor.wavjepa.
Package initializers expose only core components, omitting denoiser and optional data dependencies.
Incorrect ForwardReturn alias in upstream types initializer corrected.
TimeInverseBlockMasker and compute_mask_indices accept an optional local NumPy Generator; masker retries capped at 1000 by default.
Original EMA teacher explicitly remains in eval mode after initialization and train() calls.
JEPA accepts an optional positive integer target_length so 32160 samples are preserved exactly rather than truncated through floating-point seconds; default upstream timing is unchanged.

Inherited AudioMAE positional-utility source removed from active package and replaced by an independent 1D sinusoidal formula implementation; original source hash and historical license retained for provenance. Float32 golden outputs match the pinned original source.
Gradient checkpointing preserves encoder padding masks and also covers decoder and differentiable top-k student readout; torch.compile remains unsupported by the adapter.
Target normalization and masked-loss arithmetic use FP32 under autocast; default FP32 equations unchanged.
Added differentiable student top-k readout matching teacher layer selection, normalization, and omission of final encoder LayerNorm; original masked branch is unchanged by default.

Optional compact_masked_tokens packs visible student encoder/decoder positions before the original PyTorch Transformer layers and restores their dense positions afterward; teacher targets, weights, zero-dropout masked objective, and state-dict layout are preserved, with floating-point reduction-order differences. Disabled by default.

Added pinned ConvChannelFeatureExtractor with independent per-channel CNN weights and original channel-major concatenation; total_patches uses the exact convolution-length recurrence without a temporary forward or debug print.

Added explicit position_channels=2 to JEPA and an independently implemented two-axis sinusoidal formula for channel-major time/channel coordinates; mono position tensors and state layout are unchanged.

Corrected TimeInverseBlockMasker channel-mask concatenation from interleaved (time,channel) to channel-major (channel,time), matching the official ConvChannelFeatureExtractor and sharing context/target time indices across ears.

JEPA.forward accepts explicit fixed encoder/decoder positions for alternate crop lengths and decoder token count follows the actual mask; the adapter can share learned modules between eight longer random Nat crops and shorter chronological hierarchy windows without mutating model parameters.
scope: Core JEPA, mono and independent-channel convolutional feature extractors, masking and initialization; independent 1D/2D positional formula; no evaluation vendors or data_modules.

third_party_licenses.pos_embed: Active positional implementation is independent and contains none of the inherited AudioMAE utilities. Original source hash and LICENSE-AudioMAE retained solely as historical provenance; no broader commercial-rights claim for pretrained weights or dependencies.
